findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:229-231 + packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts:578-589 — HIGH: the story promises that the exact printed degraded command is executed through the worktree-local node bin/lattice.js entrypoint, but production guidance still prints global `lattice autopilot_review_submit` and the smoke only runs `zsh -n` syntax validation. In the self-host scenario that motivated this story, global lattice can resolve main old runtime without --deriveBindings, so all three printed commands are not proven executable and can deterministically fail while the test passes. Render the authoritative local entrypoint (or otherwise mechanically guarantee current runtime authority) and execute the exact three rendered commands in an isolated fixture, asserting three persisted complete-envelope verdicts and degraded-only 3x1 outcome.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: guidance rendered global lattice and smoke only parsed syntax. Root cause: hard-coded global runtime plus zsh -n-only coverage. Fix: node bin/lattice.js per round. ReproTest: isolated self-host fixture executes all three literal commands and asserts three complete-envelope verdicts with degraded-only assurance.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:121-130 — HIGH: --deriveBindings labels evidence current PASS and immediately turns it into gate-counting host-verdict bindings, but it only checks result/materialHash/storyFilesHash and optionally missingRequired. It does not enforce the existing routine-validation admissibility contract in phase-gates.ts:628-677: canonical lattice validate command, parseable allPass output, presence and current-input equality of verificationCoverage entries, blocking-dirty check, and head/material/storyFiles lineage freshness. The new smoke at review-escalation-smoke.ts:320-346 demonstrates the bypass by accepting synthetic evidence with command=review-escalation-smoke, output=pass (not JSON allPass), and total/required=1 with empty entries. Thus an evidence record TEST would rerun/reject can be promoted to complete canonical digests and counted by the review-assurance DONE gate. Extract/share a single validation-PASS admissibility helper with the TEST gate (or equivalently enforce every same invariant here), fail closed before persistence, and add adversarial tests for wrong command, non-allPass output, missing/stale coverage snapshot, missing freshness bindings, dirty worktree, and invalid head lineage.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: non-canonical synthetic PASS evidence was accepted. Root cause: partial result/hash check diverged from TEST. Fix: phase-gates and verdict share full canonical PASS admissibility for command, allPass, current coverage, dirty state, exact hashes and exact/trusted-metadata lineage. ReproTest: wrong command/output, missing/stale coverage, missing freshness, dirty source and invalid lineage all reject before verdict/event; validation-protocol-smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:115-182 — HIGH TOCTOU: --deriveBindings snapshots material/storyFiles/current PASS test evidence and checks all five envelope fields in withDerivedBindings(), then returns before submitLocalVerdict writes the verdict and appends the gate-consumed host_verdict event. There is no shared lock or pre-persistence revalidation. A concurrent test-evidence replacement (PASS→FAIL/new receipt) with unchanged material/storyFiles can occur after line 121 but before line 182; the stored validationDigest still reflects the old PASS. packages/main/src/core/host-independence.ts:151-179 only requires validationDigest/promptDigest to be non-empty and does not recompute them, so that stale event can count toward degraded assurance. Keep the pure helper pure (no callback/write seam); make snapshot validation and persistence one fail-closed transaction or add a safe structured revalidation immediately at the persistence boundary, with a deterministic race regression proving no verdict file/process event remains or counts.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: checked snapshot escaped before verdict/event persistence. Root cause: no validation lock spanned read-to-write. Fix: existing per-story validation execution lock now encloses admissibility, derivation, verdict write and process-event append; pure binding helper remains IO-free. ReproTest: deterministic concurrent revalidation wins lock, derived submission rejects, FAIL evidence replaces PASS, and no verdict/event remains or later counts.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md:92-99 — HIGH: the decision/runbook truth source promises one executable degraded command per round and says --deriveBindings re-resolves current PASS validation evidence before writing, but the rendered production command uses global `lattice` (packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:229-231), which can select the main/old runtime instead of this self-host worktree, and the handler PASS check (packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:121-130) does not enforce the canonical routine-validation admissibility contract. Therefore the document overstates both command executability and evidence freshness: an operator can follow it exactly yet invoke a runtime without --deriveBindings, or bind evidence TEST would reject. Make the rendered entrypoint runtime-authoritative, share/enforce the canonical PASS-admissibility predicate, execute the literal rendered commands in regression coverage, and keep this document wording aligned with those mechanically enforced guarantees.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: runbook overstated global-command executability and partial PASS freshness. Root cause: prose described intended rather than enforced behavior. Fix: doc names worktree-local runtime, shared full admissibility and lock transaction. ReproTest: literal three-command smoke, validation protocol, process-fact contract and adversarial suite pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:124-130 — HIGH: F-003 lock closure is split-brain on wrapper-root projects. submitWithDerivedBindings resolves signedWorkspaceRoot and passes it as withValidationExecutionLock.root, while packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:633,800-806 uses ctx.root as the lock root and only uses resolved git cwd as workspaceRoot. validationExecutionLockPath derives the authoritative key solely from options.root (packages/main/src/core/validation-execution-lock.ts:128-133,235), so wrapper root != signed git root creates two independent locks. Concurrent validate can therefore replace test evidence while derived verdict snapshot/file/process-event persistence proceeds, preserving the original stale-evidence counting window. The new deterministic race test uses a plain repo where root===gitRoot and cannot detect this. Use the same canonical lock root as every validation writer and add a wrapper-root contention regression proving one lock path and zero verdict/event persistence; keep the pure derivation helper callback/write-free.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: wrapper-root validation writer locked metadata root while derived submit locked signed git root, permitting concurrent mutation. Root cause: verdict used projectRoot as lock key despite validation writer authority being ctx.root. Fix: derived submission now locks ctx.root and keeps signedWorkspaceRoot diagnostic-only. ReproTest: deterministic wrapper-root fixture holds the validation lock, derived submission rejects with contention, and verdict/event counts remain zero; review-escalation smoke passes 20 checks.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:1611-1653 vs packages/main/src/core/validation-evidence-admissibility.ts:82-94 — HIGH: commit 061085c3 extracted the TEST-gate admissibility diagnostics but did not update the existing validation protocol contract assertions. `node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js` deterministically fails at wrong-command because the test expects `existing validation PASS command is not` while the shared helper emits `validation evidence command is not`; subsequent output/missing-hash expectations also retain old wording. F-001 behavior itself is fixed, and the gate remains fail-closed, but the focused protocol suite is red. Align the protocol assertions (prefer stable reason codes or canonical shared messages) and rerun the full admissibility cases so the TEST gate and deriveBindings consumer stay mechanically synchronized.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: fresh-build validation-protocol assertions failed after shared admissibility changed exact phase-gate diagnostics. Root cause: free-form shared reasons were rendered directly into a legacy user-facing contract. Fix: shared predicate emits stable structured reasonCodes and phase-gates maps them to the exact legacy diagnostics, distinguishing invalid JSON from non-allPass. ReproTest: fresh tsc build followed by validation-protocol smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/validation-evidence-admissibility.ts:91-103 / packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:620-632 — HIGH regression: extracting the shared admissibility evaluator changed the established DEV→TEST rejection diagnostics, but validation-protocol-smoke.ts:1611-1653 still pins the prior contract. A clean build followed by node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js fails deterministically at wrong-command because the log now says validation evidence command is not ..., not existing validation PASS command is not ...; later cases also distinguish invalid JSON from allPass=false and expect the prior coverage/hash wording, while the new helper collapses/renames those reasons. This blocks the configured validation suite and removes diagnostic specificity during a gate failure. Preserve shared boolean semantics while returning stable typed reason codes rendered by the phase gate to its existing messages (and a suitable deriveBindings prefix), or deliberately migrate every pinned consumer/test in the same change; rerun validation-protocol-smoke plus the focused review/quorum smokes before re-review.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: output/coverage/freshness rejection diagnostics drifted when shared admissibility prose replaced phase-specific messages. Root cause: semantic decision and presentation were coupled. Fix: structured reason codes separate shared gate semantics from the phase renderer; absent/FAIL evidence also retains the cheap legacy validate path without checklist preloading. ReproTest: validation-protocol smoke passes all pinned command, JSON, coverage, freshness, and validate-failure assertions.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md:97-103 — HIGH: the updated truth source now promises that --deriveBindings holds the story validation-execution lock across canonical admissibility, verdict persistence, and process-event persistence. That is true for plain repos but false for wrapper-root layouts: packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:124-130 keys the lock from signedWorkspaceRoot, while packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:633,800-806 keys validate from ctx.root; validation-execution-lock.ts:128-133,235 derives the lock path solely from that root. Two different roots therefore permit concurrent validation evidence replacement during the supposedly locked transaction. Align both writers on one canonical lock root, add wrapper-root contention coverage, and retain this wording only once the mechanical guarantee is layout-independent. F-006/F-007 diagnostic-message regressions do not independently require a decision-doc change because this document does not promise exact rejection text.
